hypothesis: A large completed one-hour price shock accompanied by unusually high quote volume and unusually wide intrabar range reflects temporary forced-order-flow/liquidity overshoot and has positive next-six-hour opposite-direction after-cost expectancy versus the same large-return reversal without liquidity filters.
economic_mechanism: Forced liquidations, urgent inventory transfer, and temporary order-book depletion can push price beyond short-run equilibrium. If the shock is both large relative to recent volatility and accompanied by abnormal participation and range expansion, part of the move may mean-revert as liquidity replenishes.

source.point_in_time_reason: The three instruments are fixed before outcome inspection and are mandatory replication cohorts, not winners selected from a historical ranked universe.

primary_rule.volatility_estimator: sample standard deviation of completed one-hour returns ending at t-1; signal-bar return excluded
primary_rule.shock_threshold: abs(return[t]) must be strictly greater than both absolute_return_floor and sigma_multiple * trailing_sigma
primary_rule.quote_volume_ratio: signal-bar quote_volume divided by median quote_volume of t-168..t-1
primary_rule.range_ratio: signal normalized_range divided by median normalized_range of t-168..t-1
primary_rule.direction: LONG after a qualifying negative shock; SHORT after a qualifying positive shock
primary_rule.entry: next completed bar open after the signal; no same-bar entry
primary_rule.exit: open of the bar six full one-hour bars after entry; no stop or target in v1
primary_rule.future_data_policy: No bar after signal close may enter return, volatility, quote-volume, range, direction, regime, or selection features. Future bars are used only for entry/exit labels.
primary_rule.regime_reporting: BULL when signal-bar close >= simple mean of closes t-167..t; otherwise BEAR. Reporting only; never a selector in v1.

baseline.rule: Identical absolute-return floor, trailing-volatility shock threshold, opposite direction, next-open entry, six-hour exit, chronology and costs, but no quote-volume-ratio or range-ratio requirement.
baseline.purpose: Test whether abnormal participation/range adds incremental economic value rather than merely rediscovering generic short-horizon reversal.

costs.interpretation: Composite conservative proxy for fees, bid/ask spread, slippage, funding/carry uncertainty and adverse selection because historical executable quotes/fills are unavailable.

chronology.split: 60% train / 20% validation / 20% untouched OOS by raw chronological bars

per_instrument_primary_required: primary challenger validation max-stress mean net bps >= baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
pooled_primary_required: validation first-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation second-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation max-stress mean net bps >= baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
for each validation BULL/BEAR regime with >= 6 trades, max-stress mean net bps > -60
sensitivity_required: sigma_1_75 pooled train completed trades >= 30 and validation completed trades >= 10
sigma_1_75 pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
sigma_2_25 pooled train completed trades >= 30 and validation completed trades >= 10
sigma_2_25 pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
sensitivities cannot rescue a failing primary rule

search_breadth.multiple_testing_policy: There is one eligible primary fingerprint. Three fixed instruments are mandatory replication cohorts, not winner alternatives. Sigma sensitivities are predeclared non-selectable falsifiers and cannot replace or rescue the sigma-2.0 primary.

selection_result_policy.on_data_integrity_fail: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; keep OOS locked and repair only the exact fixed-instrument data deficiency without substituting instruments.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_fail: REJECT_CURRENT_FINGERPRINT; persist negative evidence and pivot to the next materially distinct ranked hypothesis without tuning v1.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_pass: FREEZE_EXACT_FINGERPRINT_AND_DATASET; request single-candidate deep validation; untouched OOS remains unopened until that central transition is canonical.

contract_fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact JSON of this object with contract_sha256 and contract_fingerprint_definition omitted
